title: The Quiet Compass
author: Wren Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Zhou, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
